desc:
You play as Aris. He dares to uncover the dark secrets behind the old building that is his grandfather's legacy.. Many horror stories originate from the inherited house of the grandfather, which has been empty for a long time. Heated family conflicts and broken last wills are often linked to relentless mystical terror that keeps emerging. Eventually, because they couldn't withstand the supernatural terror, all family members chose to move and live separately, leaving the house behind.

WARNING!
This game features high psychological horror, fear, and loud sounds. Not recommended for people with a history of heart disease or those triggered by such themes.

This game was created by a single developer and is still in the development stage. If you find any bugs, your reports and feedback are very valuable!
